rationale: Neither document names the source (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering / notes/white-bear-4b.md) explicitly or unmistakably; the write-up's Novelty section gives an indirect pointer to the repo's prior 'centring work' (J(h-mu)) and explicitly carves the new method's novelty out against it, which is the closest either document gets to crediting/contrasting with the source lineage. The closing message omits any such reference entirely, instead naming a different, non-source paper ('Herrera 2026') as a consistency check for a null control, so it tells strictly less about the source/novelty relationship than the write-up, while the substantive result and method claims it makes about the write-up's content are accurate.
